# TOK-412: Tokenize Request Validation (v1.3)

Owner: Payments Platform
Status: Approved for Q4 release

## Scope
Validates POST /v1/tokenize bodies before they reach the vault. Errors are returned as a list of {path, code, message}. Paths use dot notation with array indexes in brackets.

## Card object
- card.number (PAN): 13 to 19 digits after removing spaces and hyphens. Must pass the Luhn checksum. Errors must not include the PAN or any substring of it.
- card.exp_month: integer 1-12.
- card.exp_year: 4-digit integer.
- Expiry is evaluated as the last day of the month, in UTC, against the processing date. Expired cards are rejected. Expiry more than 10 years out is rejected.
- card.cvv: 3 or 4 digits. Allowed only in the transient request. If persist=true, card.cvv or card.security_code at any depth is a hard error.

## Billing
- card.billing.address.line1, city, postal_code, country are required.
- country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase.
- Strings are NFC normalized before length checks. Max 200 chars each.

## Nulls and empties
- Required field null: error.
- Required field "" or whitespace only: treated as missing.
- Optional fields may be null, equivalent to absent.

## Structural limits
- Max nesting depth: 6. A value at depth 7 is an error.
- metadata: flat object, string values only, max 20 keys, keys <= 40 chars, values <= 500 chars.

## token_policy
- single_use: boolean, default false.
- ttl_seconds: integer, 60 to 86400 inclusive.
